scope: The observer fast path applies only to the canonical IndexedOrdinaryOwned values reached by this Motion scenario. It replaces recursive Type-valued optional-array observation with indexed owner swaps and an exact physical Doc reconstruction. Reader execution, schedules, callbacks, captures, physical values, metadata, and output fields are unchanged.

change.behavior: For the owned indexed carrier, extract metadata capacity/depth, check actual Array.size equals capacity, require 1 <= capacity <= 131072, depth <= 17, and capacity == 1 << depth. On that path, scan logical slots with Array.swap; each Some value is projected exactly once and the returned P owner is restored with Array.set before the next slot. None uses Doc.NoneLeaf, Some uses Doc.wrapped_leaf, and carry builds parents with Doc.physical_node in original left-to-right order. Mismatched/unsupported metadata uses the prior optional_values structural observer. Plain/raw Column and other fallback branches remain untouched.
change.shapeLimitation: The metadata and Array.size checks do not by themselves prove an arbitrary raw array balanced. The indexed traversal is scoped to the source path below: all three scenario columns start at Col.empty_indexed and are updated through canonical indexed APIs. No claim is made for user-constructed unbalanced states with matching metadata.

factoryProvenance.fact: The scenario creates Position, Velocity, and Selected using Col.empty_indexed.
empty_indexed creates a one-leaf None array and M.empty metadata; absent recursively creates balanced all-None arrays.
indexed_ensure grows values by pairing the old complete array with absent children while doubling size and incrementing depth; standard indexed updates retain the array shape.
Metadata starts with capacity 1/depth 0; write_grow pairs old arrays with same-sized zero arrays while doubling capacity and incrementing depth.
The canonical indexed update/lifecycle paths use Array.swap/Array.set and metadata updates; these preserve the factory tree shape.

wire: This preserves each original leaf and branch constructor: NoneLeaf, wrapped_leaf, physical_node. The carry combines the same complete balanced tree shape in the same left/right order. Full consumer oracle equality remains required.
qualification: Source/type-check evidence only until the unchanged full Motion64 JS and Native consumers compare byte-for-byte to the independent oracle. No performance claim.
